original_test_intent: Exercise exactly 10,000 approved PCIe L1 power-management entry/exit transitions on the mapped GB-NV-PVP link and prove every transition reaches the intended low-power state and returns within the accepted latency without link, endpoint, GPU, host, or platform error.
original_method: Approve the L1 mechanism, L1 versus L1.1/L1.2 scope, policy, workload-idle condition, wake stimulus, topology, residency, latency, and error contract; baseline capabilities and state; record each numbered entry, confirmed residency, exit stimulus, wake completion, negotiated link, and error/health deltas durably before the next cycle; stop on first anomaly and restore policy only through the approved method.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE approves ASPM/L1 ownership, exact substate and latency contract; an operator isolates the SUT, watches out-of-band state, and owns recovery or policy restoration after a failed wake.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual L1 configuration compatible with platform firmware and driver
Exact root-port/bridge/retimer/endpoint/GPU and sibling topology with L1/L1SS capability
ASPM ownership, L1/L1.1/L1.2 scope, idle/workload, residency, wake stimulus, latency, and negotiated-link rules
10,000-cycle count, durable storage, error-delta, abort, policy-restoration, final-state, and recovery contract
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production SUT and explicit 10,000-transition approval
No unsaved workload and verified out-of-band console
Do not force a state or substate unsupported by both ends of the path
Stop on failed entry/residency/exit, wake timeout, link loss/downtraining, endpoint disappearance, new AER, GPU/host reset, thermal/power anomaly, tool fault, or evidence gap
No evidence clearing, blind retry, or unapproved ASPM-policy mutation
agent_execution_scope: Validate capabilities, target, policy owner, baseline, interlocks, and ledger
Run only the approved L1 entry/exit method and wake stimulus
Commit entry, residency, exit, latency, link, and error status before the next cycle
Correlate power-management state with link, endpoint, GPU, host, and platform health
Do not infer substate, force unsupported policy, continue after fault, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve L1 mechanism/substate, complete link scope, and 10,000-cycle risk
Define entry, minimum residency, wake stimulus, latency, link, and error acceptance
Own first-fault disposition, policy restoration, and recovery
Review the full ledger and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It names the vendor tool family but treats L1 as generic link training, omits the substate/policy/wake/latency contract, and a final lspci/dmesg sweep cannot prove 10,000 successful entries and exits.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned L1 configuration with an atomic cycle ledger and an interlock that blocks cycle N+1 until N proves intended entry/residency, approved wake stimulus, exit latency, restored link state, and acceptable error deltas.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LTSSM, exactly 10,000 L1 transitions, no-error acceptance, no bundle, and 60/1440-minute allocation remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: INTERLOCKED 10,000x PCIE L1 ENTRY EXIT SOAK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each L1 cycle as a power-state transaction containing observable entry, residency, wake, exit latency, restored link, and health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines ASPM ownership, L1 substate, idle/residency/wake conditions, latency, evidence durability, policy restoration, aborts, and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final active L0 link cannot prove that any L1 entry occurred, that residency was sufficient, or that earlier wake latency and transient errors were acceptable.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsupported or conflicting firmware/OS/vendor control can prevent entry, strand the endpoint, create latency faults, reset the GPU/host, or invalidate state observations.

project_override_considerations: A policy-counter or trace-based proof of L1 residency may replace direct tool state only when its mapping, sample loss, timestamp basis, and path coverage are approved. Setup, retries, incomplete entries/exits, or unproven residency do not count.
expected_evidence: Pinned tool/configuration, path topology, capabilities, and initial ASPM/L1 policy
Monotonic 1-10000 lossless ledger with entry and exit timestamps, measured latency, link state, and cycle disposition
Correlated L1/L1SS counters or traces, lspci/AER/dmesg/journal/GPU/BMC/SEL/console/thermal/power evidence
First-fault recovery or clean restored policy and final endpoint/link/host state, followed by engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, and Criteria consistently require 10,000 L1 transitions. DeepSeek's speed-change wording is imprecise but still identifies the same row and vendor LTSSM family; missing substate and latency semantics are readiness decisions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The L1 transition purpose is identifiable and can be planned safely. Proprietary tooling, capability, policy, latency, topology, evidence, and recovery inputs gate execution but do not create an irreducible review blocker.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2119 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00040-V002: approve the exact LTSSM/NVQual L1/ASPM mechanism and root-port/bridge/retimer/endpoint scope, L1 versus L1.1/L1.2 target, policy owner, idle/residency/wake stimulus and latency rules, exact 10,000-cycle/checkpoint evidence, acceptable link/AER/error deltas, first-fault interlocks, restored policy, and out-of-band recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves all 10,000 L1 transitions while requiring proof of entry and residency as well as exit, rather than accepting a final active-link snapshot as transition evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe L1 is a power-management state, not merely a speed retrain. Valid coverage depends on who controls ASPM, whether the target is base L1 or an L1 substate, an idle condition sufficient for entry, observable residency, a deterministic wake stimulus, and measured exit latency. The link returning to L0 at the end proves none of those intermediate facts. Therefore each cycle needs state-and-time evidence, and the next cycle must be inhibited after a missed entry, failed wake, downtraining, or error delta so a power-management fault is not hidden by later recovery.
